aggregation_order: Validate exact snapshot, runtime fingerprint, module identities and physical directional bindings.
Consume runtime efficiency/availability and precomputed balance uses; do not allocate or balance again.
Apply each engine actual_output_percent once to that actuator's runtime use force, torque and fuel rate.
Preserve unavailable actuator identities with zero contributions; sort by actuator identity and sum with math.fsum.

fuel_policy.delivery_fraction: min(1, available_fuel / requested_step_fuel) if requested_step_fuel > 0 else 1
fuel_policy.refresh_boundary: Motion fuel, hull and layer must match runtime before integration. Recompile after changes; stale model/runtime is rejected.

preserved_physics: Old allocator, drag and soft-safety inputs remain unchanged in integrate_tactical_step.
The shared delivered-actuation helper preserves old mass/inertia, turn_scale, body/world transforms, semi-implicit position, layer transition, load and overload hull-damage formulas.
The actual-output path never invokes the allocator or soft limiter; crew safety lock does not silently rescale its forces.
boundary_limits: Explicit actual requests are finite, versioned force requests with source fingerprints and step, not signatures proving aggregation or gameplay safety.
Existing off/tripped engine states are consumed with zero output; no hard-fault transition is implemented.
Opposing target or actual channels are rejected while direction interlock remains unwired.
No unified scene advancement or engine state advancement is introduced.
availability_fixture_note: The original fixture's automated engine.throttle correctly remains available without crew. Zero-crew and zero-power checks use separate in-memory manual and electrically loaded variants (the latter reuses an existing power category). No production propulsion power-category policy or fixture asset is changed.
schema_validation: Three closed shape declarations, payload top-level shapes and all local request references checked. Contextual Python contracts enforce numerical, identity and source invariants. No external JSON Schema validation engine run.
